description: Replaces the 'cache=None' sentinel-and-init pattern with a mutable default argument 'cache={}', which is evaluated once and shared across every call site that omits the parameter.

findings.summary: Mutable default argument cache={} is shared across all calls that omit it
findings.evidence: The 'cache=None' plus 'if cache is None: cache = {}' guard was removed in favor of 'cache={}' as the default; Python evaluates default arguments once at def time, so every caller relying on the default now shares and mutates the same dict across calls.
